title: Chapter 12 — Before Friday
description: Felix comes back on Friday. Three days to decide who stays, who hides, and who believes in Italy.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Tuesday. Felix's deadline is Friday. Everybody in the house knows. Nobody says it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: His bag is in your ceiling. Half a million naira. You can hear it at night, like a generator in another house.

beats.speaker: precious
beats.text: (at the bar, too casually) Mama. Is Italy really that bad? Joy's sister is in Milan. She posts pictures. Shoes. A balcony. A dog in a jacket.

variants.text: (at the bar, with her computer-course notebook) Mama. Joy's sister is in Milan. Shoes, a balcony. (She closes the notebook.) Sometimes I think, why am I learning Excel when I could be on a balcony?

beats.speaker: precious
beats.text: She wants you to say it's fine.

options.text: Show her the NAPTIP pictures Officer Grace gave you. All of them.
"Ask Kemi about her cousin." Leave it there.
"Italy is whatever you make it, my dear."

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: Mama, my aunt in Agege has two rooms. If you want the girls out of the house on Friday, she won't ask questions. She owes me.

beats.speaker: kemi
beats.text: Kokoro is listening from the gate.

options.text: Send all the girls to Kemi's aunt on Thursday night.
"Nobody leaves. This is our house. We face him here."

beats.speaker: kokoro
beats.text: (cleaning a broom handle like it is a rifle) Mama. On Friday I need two things. Boys from the motor park, and you not to do anything foolish.

beats.speaker: kokoro
beats.text: Head of security. (He says it to himself, like a man trying on a jacket.) Okay. I will earn it this week.

beats.speaker: kokoro
beats.text: Motor park boys cost money. Brave ones cost more.

options.text: Hire four boys from Baba Ticket's park.

beats.speaker: ivie
beats.text: (calling at midnight, whispering from the dormitory) Mummy, Kemi texted me. She said "pray for us on Friday". What is Friday?

beats.speaker: ivie
beats.text: She is sixteen. She is not stupid.

options.text: "Something bad is coming, and Mummy is going to stop it."
Tell her everything, including the bag.
options.lockedText: There is nothing like that to tell

beats.title: Before Friday
beats.summary: Three days. You hid who you could, armed who you could, and told your daughter whatever you could bear to.
